articles.summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) plans to announce results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026, which ended March 29, 2026, before markets open on Thursday, May 14, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 results at 8:30am ET on Thursday, May 14, 2026. A live webcast of the conference call will be available on the company’s website at http://investor.canadagoose.com . The conference call can be accessed by using the following link: Canada Goose Q4 2026 Earnings Call . After registering, an email including the conference call link will be sent to join the live call. An archived replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call. articles.summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. ("Canada Goose" or the "Company") (NYSE: GOOS) (TSX: GOOS) today announced that its Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the board of directors, Dani Reiss, established an automatic securities disposition plan (ASDP) in accordance with applicable United States and Canadian securities legislation and the Company's internal policies. The ASDP permits trades to be made in accordance with pre-arranged instructions given when Mr. Reiss was not in possession of any material undisclosed information. The ASDP will be effective on the later of (i) 90 days following the date hereof, and (ii) the second trading day following the date on which the Company has filed its interim financial statements for the quarter ending June 28, 2026. Sales of the subordinate voting shares under the ASDP may only commence as of such effective date.
